name: minions-availability-workspace
description: Availability snapshots, slot states, and change detection for tent reservations
author: Mehdi Nabhani <mehdi@the-mehdi.com> (https://the-mehdi.com)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @minions-availability/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/cli run build && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/docs run build && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/blog run build && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/web run build
scripts.deploy:blog: pnpm --filter @minions-availability/blog run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/blog/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter @minions-availability/docs run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/docs/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter @minions-availability/web run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/web/dist --prod
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @minions-availability/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/sdk run lint && pnpm --filter @minions-availability/cli run lint
